title: Food tour experience
text: We had a great time with Paula! She was very lively and brought us to wonderful food spots! She has lots of interesting stories from her life to add to conversations and she was extremely helpful!
author: 252shreyad

title: Tapas with some friends
text: We took the 3-hour Tapas tour the day we arrived in Barcelona to get a feel for how Tapas works in Spain.  The tour is limited to 6 guests and we were lucky enough to have just us our guide Paula and a wonderful English lady named Shiela.  We had such a nice time.  Paula took us to three small tapas bars that we would never have found on our own.  At each stop we had a drink and at at least one Tapa (3 at the last stop). author: Chuck_C

title: Enjoyable and informative !
text: We had a lovely time on our tapas tour- learning so many tidbits about Barcelona and Catalan culture while trying delicious bites and unfamiliar, but very tasty drink options!
author: eminahan

title: HIGHLY Recommend!
text: We had an amazing tour with Paula! She had cancellations and it ended up being just 2 of us which was great for us! She introduced us to 3 quaint spots, tapas and vermouth at the first spot, which we completely fell in love with and never would have ordered on our own. She had us trying things out of our comfort zone and we loved it all! Her explanation of the history of Barcelona and the food traditions made us love the city even more. author: Relax39723379437

title: Paula was fantastic!
text: Paula was amazing! Food and drinks were fantastic and we definitely saw small local places we likely would not have known about. As someone who doesn’t typically sign  for a “tour“ Paula made us feel like we were just meeting with friends that live in Barcelona.
author: 956grantj

title: Best tapas tour - Paula showed us the real Barcelona
text: After booking and loving Barcelona Bike Tour ran by Buena Vista I enquired about a tapas tour and I am so glad I asked and found myself on this tour. Paula the guide took my husband and I on a private tapas tour around Barcelona and it was 10/10. Stricly local spots only with no other tourists, absolutely delicious food (that I would have never known to order myself) and a really memorable afternoon. Thank you!
author: madisonl629

title: The Ultimate Barcelona Tapas Experience
text:
One of the absolute highlights of our time in Barcelona! This tapas tour was the perfect way to experience the city’s food, culture, and energy all in one unforgettable evening.

From the moment we started, it felt like being shown around by a local friend rather than a tour guide. We visited a fantastic mix of traditional and modern tapas bars — places we never would have found on our own — and every stop offered something special. The food was incredible: fresh, authentic, and beautifully explained.

title: Taste it!

title: Loved this tapas tour!
text: A fantastic tapas tour, relaxed, fun and lots of yummy food i would not have tried otherwise. A brilliant way to discover local spots, make friends and hear the stories behind them. Highly recommend.

title: Authentic tapas, great fun!
text: Such a great tour! The guide took us to amazing tapas places that felt like where all the locals go. She had great knowledge of the city. We had an absolute blast. Highly recommend!! Will do this every time I come back to Barcelona
